profile.baseline: authorized owner identity reads its own disposable protected profile
profile.candidate: distinct attacker identity requests the same owner-owned profile
profile.negative_control: attacker identity requests an unrelated protected/nonexistent profile
profile.expected_invariant: an attacker identity cannot receive the owner-owned profile semantic identity
profile.violated_invariant: attacker receives the owner-owned profile semantic identity
required_observables: owner identity and attacker identity are independently target-controlled
same owner resource is referenced by baseline and candidate
candidate response is semantically distinguishable from owner baseline
negative control is independently denied or unrelated
snapshot restore returns the same target state hash

blocker.reason: The current WebGoat source uses a LessonSession-controlled identity and does not expose an approved target-local mechanism for two independently controlled sessions, a disposable owner-owned resource, and reset/state-hash verification. The login endpoint mutates LessonSession and is outside the approved GET-only/no-login boundary.
blocker.required_capability: An explicitly approved target-local fixture/session mechanism providing synthetic owner and attacker identities, an opaque owner-owned resource, ownership relation, deterministic reset, and bounded semantic authorization observations.

validation.interpretation: The profile contract and preflight gate are validated; no target-backed detection-quality claim is made.
